title: scim-reconciliation-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.sso.directory-sync-apply; exact inputs: tenant_id, connection_id, cursor, mapping_version, remote_changes; initial state: connection has a committed cursor and local authoritative ownership map

stimulus.const: Run identity.sso.directory-sync-apply for success, failure, denial, outage, replay, concurrency, unknown-outcome cases using tenant_id, connection_id, cursor, mapping_version, remote_changes and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: reconciliation applies each remote version once, preserves application-owned fields, reports conflicts, and advances cursor only after commit; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, denial=denied/forbidden, outage=unavailable/unavailable, replay=denied/conflict, concurrency=pass/conflict, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: connection_id, applied_change_count, conflict_count, previous_cursor_digest, committed_cursor_digest, reconciliation_cases
